title: Open Derm Trial Atlas drug record (schema v1)

drug.description: canonical drug name; joins molecule.drug on every trial of this drug

mechanism_of_action.description: typed mechanism from the FDA label section 12.1; label text in source_excerpt

boxed_warning.description: typed boxed warning; present=false is a confirmed absence

application_number.description: null only when regulatory_application itself is needs_extraction

regulatory_application.description: NDA/BLA join key for Orange/Purple Book

orange_book.description: Orange Book patents + exclusivities (small-molecule NDAs only)

items.description: One FDA application this drug holds

applications.description: one entry per distinct FDA application this drug holds -- almost always exactly 1; Roflumilast is the one drug in this corpus with 2 (cream NDA 215985, foam NDA 217242)

purple_book.description: Purple Book licensure + BPCIA exclusivity (biologic BLAs only)

trial_ids.description: NCT ids of every trial of this drug in this atlas -- informational back-reference, not authoritative (data/trials/*.json's molecule.drug is)

description: One drug's cross-indication facts, extracted once and referenced (not copied) by every trial of this drug -- see atlas/drugs.py
